The degree of radiographic change at 6 weeks differs: a significant reduction in the size of the erosive changes (text) versus mild resolution of the erosive lesions (Figure 2 caption).
The text cites Figure 2b for the CT study, but Figure 2 has no panel b and shows a radiograph; the CT image is panel b of Figure 1.
The discussion says an inflammatory or self-limiting autoimmune cause might explain the disease; this is speculation, not a diagnosis.
Hip findings differ in laterality wording: hip joints (abstract), mild bilateral hip laxity (discussion), left hip extension mildly restricted compared to the right at the recheck.
